title: 教職概論（夏期集中講義）
subtitle: Survey of Teaching Profession
educationalGoal: In this course, you will learn about the significance and the role of the teaching profession and the job contents of the teacher. While reflecting on learning in the teacher certification program, you will deepen your understanding of the future school education, and cultivate practical leadership skills for education.
advice:
In order to establish teaching profession and develop practical leadership as a teacher, this course will be conducted with the following contents. In the discussion, each group discusses the specified theme and summarizes it in a worksheet.
 1. The significance of teaching profession
 2. Teacher’s responsibility, identity security, and teacher work
 3. The significance of teacher training
 4. Choosing a career path for teaching
requiredKnowledge: Aiming to obtain a Japanese teacher's license

activityGoals.body: Be able to answer questions about the significance and the role of the teaching profession correctly.
Be able to answer the questions about the status and the responsibility of a teacher correctly.
Be able to state the effective teaching profession in reports.
Be able to engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1) Acquire knowledge across the teaching profession and link them organically to analyze modern education issues and identify issues.
2) Summarize the strengths and weaknesses of the past school education and clarify the direction for new education.
3) Be aware of the responsibility as a teacher and have the desire to lead the school.

              In this course, you will learn about the significance and the role of the teaching profession and the job contents of the teacher. While reflecting on learning in the teacher certification program, you will deepen your understanding of the future school education, and cultivate practical leadership skills for education.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In order to establish teaching profession and develop practical leadership as a teacher, this course will be conducted with the following contents. In the discussion, each group discusses the specified theme and summarizes it in a worksheet.
 1. The significance of teaching profession
 2. Teacher’s responsibility, identity security, and teacher work
 3. The significance of teacher training
 4. Choosing a career path for teaching
